The '''Inn of the Valley''' is the local inn in [[Tobin's Hollow]].

==Appearance==
The Inn of the Valley is the center of the rural community of Tobin's Hollow. Travelers, peddlers, and gleemen used it as a resting point between Tobin's Hollow and [[Falme]], the [[Village Council]] held its meetings there, and farmers often relaxed at the inn.

Even after the [[Seanchan]] occupation, it remains the center of activity. The common room has been turned into an impromptu command center. The well-kept inn contains six guest rooms, quarters for its staff, and a private suite for important guests.

Lord [[Timak]] currently occupies the suite, and his officer, [[Murdoc]], and ''[[sul'dam]]'', [[Serrah]], each have a private room. All ''[[damane]]'' are kept in servants' quarters in the attic.

Murdoc and his ten soldiers watch the village from the common in front of the inn. The inn's back door is not guarded, but anyone approaching is in full view of the guards behind the stations.<ref name="RPG">''[[The Wheel of Time Roleplaying Game]]''</ref>
